description: Rank platforms by what one generation of a model costs, the same way choiflix.md does: for each platform, the plan with the lowest per-generation cost (including annual billing and active promotions unless billing is set), as the share of the subscription price used by the credits. Ranks apply to comparable quotes with current plan and credit evidence. Estimates have no rank.

billing.description: Which billing cycles to consider. Default 'all' (monthly and annual, like the website).

qty.description: Duration in seconds (for video/audio) or image count.

name: quote_cheapest_platform
